questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: We decided ______ the museum after lunch.
questions.solution: decide后通常接动词不定式作宾语，结构为decide to do，因此应选to visit。
questions.title: decide后接动词不定式

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: My teacher encouraged me ______ the speaking competition.
questions.solution: encourage sb. to do sth.表示“鼓励某人做某事”，所以使用to enter。
questions.title: encourage宾补中的不定式

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: To improve your English, it is important ______ every day.
questions.solution: 句型It is important to do sth.中，it是形式主语，动词不定式作真正主语，因此选to practice。
questions.title: 形式主语句型中的不定式

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: ______ books before bed helps me relax.
questions.solution: 句中缺少主语，Reading books是动名词短语作主语，谓语使用第三人称单数helps。
questions.title: 动名词短语作主语

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: ______ enough sleep is necessary for students to stay focused in class.
questions.solution: Getting enough sleep为动名词短语，在句中作主语，表示“获得充足睡眠”这件事。
questions.title: 动名词主语与主谓一致

questions.subject: 英语
knowledge_points: 定语从句关系词的选择
questions.question: The book ______ I borrowed from the library is very useful.
questions.solution: 先行词the book指物，关系词在从句中作borrowed的宾语，可用that，因此选that。
questions.title: 关系代词that的选择

questions.subject: 英语
knowledge_points: 定语从句关系词的选择
questions.question: This is the classroom ______ we had our first English lesson.
questions.solution: 先行词the classroom表示地点，关系词在从句中作地点状语，因此使用where。
questions.title: 关系副词where的选择

questions.subject: 英语
knowledge_points: 定语从句关系词的选择
questions.question: The student ______ mother is a doctor won the speech contest.
questions.solution: 关系词修饰从句中的mother，表示“这个学生的母亲”，需要使用表示所属关系的whose。
questions.title: 关系代词whose的选择

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: She ______ in Xining since she was ten years old.
questions.solution: since she was ten years old表示动作从过去持续到现在，应使用现在完成时has lived。
questions.title: since引导的现在完成时

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: I ______ this movie twice, so I know the story well.
questions.solution: twice表示截至现在已有两次经历，且结果与现在相关，应使用现在完成时have seen。
questions.title: 经历用法的现在完成时

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question: —Can I borrow your dictionary? —Sorry, I ______ it to Li Ming.
questions.solution: 说话时字典仍在李明处，过去借出的动作对现在造成“无法借给你”的结果，因此使用现在完成时have lent。
questions.title: 强调现在结果的完成时

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Li Hua studies for forty minutes and then takes a ten-minute break. During the break, he stands up, drinks some water, and looks out of the window. He says this habit helps him stay focused.

How long is Li Hua's break?
questions.solution: 原文直接说明“takes a ten-minute break”，因此休息时间为十分钟。
questions.title: 学习间隔时间细节

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.

The school science club meets every Wednesday afternoon in Room 204. Students need to bring a notebook, but the club provides all the experiment materials. New members should arrive ten minutes early for a safety introduction.

What should new members bring?
questions.solution: 原文说“Students need to bring a notebook”，实验材料由社团提供，因此新成员应带笔记本。
questions.title: 科学社团准备事项细节

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question:
Read the passage and choose the best title.

Keeping a small vocabulary notebook can make English study more effective. Write down new words with an example sentence instead of only copying their Chinese meanings. Review a few words each day, and try to use them in speaking or writing.
options: How to Use a Vocabulary Notebook
How to Write a Long Essay
questions.solution: 全文围绕如何记录、复习和使用词汇笔记展开，最佳标题是“How to Use a Vocabulary Notebook”。
questions.title: 词汇笔记方法主旨

questions.subject: 英语
questions.question:
Read the passage and choose the main idea.

Many students think exercise takes time away from study. However, a short walk or several minutes of stretching can reduce stress and help the brain stay active. The key is not to exercise for hours, but to make brief movement a regular part of the day.
options: Students should stop studying to exercise for hours.
Brief regular exercise can support effective study.
Walking is the only useful form of exercise.
Stress has no influence on learning.
questions.solution: 文章先提出误区，再说明短时间、规律的运动能减压并保持大脑活跃，主旨是适量规律运动有助于学习。
questions.title: 短时运动与学习主旨
